task: Implement hash_password for the auth service without using the storage service hash approach.

candidate_memories.content: Auth service hash_password uses Argon2id with the project-standard cost parameters for user credentials.
Auth hashing cost parameters are set to balance security and login latency across the expected load.
Stored hashes must include the algorithm version tag so future re-hashing is detectable.
When hash_password appears in auth and storage contexts, verify the algorithm and versioning contract.
Storage service: hash_password computes a BLAKE3 hash of file content for deduplication purposes.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: BLAKE3 content-addressed storage hash is not suitable for credential storage

candidate_memories.content: Old security note says all hashing should use a unified hash_password function for consistency.
